title: Hepatoprotective action of Sonchus oleraceus against paracetamol-induced toxicity via Nrf2/KEAP-1/HO-1 pathway in relation to its metabolite fingerprint and in silico studies.
authors: Abdelhameed, Mohamed F; El-Baset, Marawan A; Khattab, Amira R; Taher, Rehab F; El-Saied, Mohamed A; Abd Elkarim, Asmaa S; Essa, Ahmed F; El-Rashedy, Ahmed A; Farag, Mohamed A; Imagawa, Hiroshi; Elshamy, Abdelsamed I; Abd-ElGawad, Ahmed M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苦苣菜提取物对扑热息痛肝毒性的保护作用，涉及Nrf2通路和分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Paracetamol overdose causes severe hepatotoxicity. Sonchus oleraceus is traditionally used to treat liver disorders, but its potential against paracetamol-induced liver injury is unexplored. This work aimed to investigate the protective mechanisms of an S. oleraceus extract (SOEtOH) using in vivo, histological and biochemical assessments along with metabolomics profiling and in silico studies, including molecular docking and dynamic simulations (MD). METHODS AND FINDINGS: SOEtOH was administered to rats with paracetamol-induced hepatotoxicity at 50, 100, and 200 mg/kg doses. Serum enzymes, hepatic antioxidants, and histopathology were evaluated. UPLC-MS characterized bioactive metabolites and molecular docking and assessed their anti-inflammatory potential. SOEtOH significantly restored serum ALT and AST toward normal levels in a dose-dependent manner. It also replenished depleted hepatic glutathione (up to 3.9-fold) and superoxide dismutase (up to 4.7-fold). Immunohistochemistry revealed SOEtOH progressively attenuated caspase-3 expression related to apoptosis. It also ameliorated characteristic histopathological alterations like necrosis, inflammation, and sinusoidal congestion. Thirty-two bioactive metabolites, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, were identified. Molecular docking revealed potent anti-inflammatory effects via JNK inhibition, with luteolin-O-dihexoside, isorhamnetin-O-hexoside, di-O-caffeoylquinic, and kaempferol-O-hexoside having the strongest binding affinities. MD simulations demonstrated that these compounds' complexes significantly contribute to JNK1 and JNK2's catalytic binding site. CONCLUSION: This integrated study demonstrates that SOEtOH protects against paracetamol hepatotoxicity by mitigating oxidative stress and inhibiting pro-inflammatory/apoptotic signaling. Our results reveal therapeutic lead compounds that may be further explored for clinical applications.
abstract_zh: 背景：对乙酰氨基酚过量会导致严重肝毒性。苦苣菜（Sonchus oleraceus）传统上用于治疗肝脏疾病，但其对对乙酰氨基酚诱导的肝损伤的潜在保护作用尚未被探索。本研究旨在通过体内实验、组织学和生化评估，结合代谢组学分析及计算机模拟研究（包括分子对接和动力学模拟 (molecular docking and dynamic simulations, MD)），探讨苦苣菜提取物（SOEtOH）的保护机制。方法与结果：以50、100和200 mg/kg剂量对乙酰氨基酚诱导肝毒性的大鼠给予SOEtOH。评估血清酶、肝脏抗氧化剂和组织病理学。UPLC-MS表征了生物活性代谢物，并通过分子对接评估了其抗炎潜力。SOEtOH以剂量依赖性方式显著将血清ALT和AST恢复至正常水平。它还补充了耗竭的肝脏谷胱甘肽（高达3.9倍）和超氧化物歧化酶（高达4.7倍）。免疫组织化学显示SOEtOH逐渐减弱了与凋亡相关的caspase-3表达。它还改善了特征性组织病理学改变，如坏死、炎症和窦状隙充血。鉴定出32种生物活性代谢物，包括黄酮类、酚酸类和萜类。分子对接揭示了通过JNK抑制的强效抗炎作用，其中木犀草素-O-二己糖苷、异鼠李素-O-己糖苷、二-O-咖啡酰奎宁酸和山柰酚-O-己糖苷具有最强的结合亲和力。MD模拟表明，这些化合物的复合物显著有助于JNK1和JNK2的催化结合位点。结论：这项综合研究表明，SOEtOH通过减轻氧化应激和抑制促炎/凋亡信号传导，保护免受对乙酰氨基酚肝毒性。我们的结果揭示了治疗性先导化合物，可进一步探索其临床应用。
